title: 第13章 麻烦与解决麻烦第14章 学院来人
lines: 格林被贞德背回了家，贴心的贞德甚至为了让格林更舒服些而脱下了盔甲。
她真的，我哭死。
就是枪有点难压，好在格林已经越发熟练了。
在这样下去，说不定可以枪枪爆头了。
在向贞德郑重地道谢后，格林回到了房间，洗漱完后走进了他的办公室里研究资料。
关于商会问题，格林打算去伊莎贝拉家族那里看看，尝尝咸淡，之后再考虑一下。
除此之外，还有一个小麻烦，事情要从3天前说起：一个子爵的领地在这附近，他看格林的生意这么好，也就过来这边品尝。
但是贵族吗？难免有些架子，而这个子爵又是其中非常突出的存在。
他认为平民应该给他让路，也就是插队，然后他还想一个人独揽所有甜品。
格林当然不会给他脸，在交涉无果后，双方自然会爆发冲突——指格林单方面把对方打倒在地。
之后就是帝国军过来调解，虽然格林目前属于平民，但是谁也说不准以后会怎样。
毕竟不管商业合作的协议怎样，三大商会在拉拢格林是事实。
三大商会都能从蜜语坊不断推出的新品和蜜语坊全新的商业模式看出，格林拥有不一般的知识。
在这个世界里，知识往往可以联系到天界众神或者深渊恶魔大公一类存在，拥有丰富知识的人很容易被这些存在注意。
不管这个人是好还是坏，反正这个人可能拥有神级存在的赐福，那么这个人就值得重视。
与深渊敌对的是圣火教会，而帝国的贵族们真正敌对的是扰乱帝国秩序的异教徒，而非整个深渊。
甚至于有人借助深渊的力量，毕竟深渊不怎么索取回报，因为当你寻求深渊力量的时候，你就已经在支付代价了。
当然，这样的人被教会发现的下场就是被审判，因为信奉天界众神，教会的高级战力或多或少有点什么赐福。
虽然有些赐福会很怪，比如可以分清楚盐和白糖的区别，但是战力还是可以保证的。
说回话题，这件事告一段落后，街坊里出现了关于蜜语坊的谣言。
格林用脑干想都能知道是谁搞得鬼，很多谣言十分低级。
不用蜜语坊回应，街坊邻居就开始讨伐造谣者了。
后面两天里，子爵都在找茬，但是都不痛不痒，格林很想说这不纯小孩吗？但是格林自己搜集情报的时候发现了一些不一样的东西：有人在谈论古兹的事情，有关于古兹会给他人带来灾厄的事情。
原本因为格林的缘故，古兹这个假特点已经快被人们遗忘了，现在竟然又被人提起来了。
啧，看来某人路走窄了。
其实从格林这几天的观察来看，古兹应该没有什么特别体质。
而且古兹的家乡就在德尔克（格林目前所在城镇名）附近，在那里调查了一下。
格林发现古兹的父母是在和商队一起远行时去世的，那不是什么不幸，而是一场深渊异教徒的袭击。
异教徒大祭祀主持了针对西方一个重要城市的大型袭击，而周围也遭受到了不同程度的攻击。
古兹父母所在的商队也在其中，这可不能称为引发灾厄，你不能说双子大厦里的人遭到攻击，是因为某人有灾厄体质吸引了飞机创了过来，原因不是这样归纳的。
而古兹为什么还活着呢？因为袭击是突然且短暂的，那个大祭祀追求破坏，而且还要求快速，所以异教徒离开时都没有发现：一对父母的尸体下方有一个颤抖的孩子。
后面古兹被帝国军送回了家乡，古兹很坚强，她依靠亲人的帮助生活了下来，后面又发生了一些事情。
不知道是那个小孩传出来的消息，总之后面许多人都说古兹的灾厄体质。
然后古兹成年后不想依靠亲戚的帮助了，就开始尝试了自己生活，之后发现找不到工作，于是开始当起了扒手，专挑富人偷些零零碎碎的钱。
那些富人也确实不会在意这些，甚至按古兹描述，有些人甚至根本没有发现自己的钱少了。
之后古兹还有一些余力帮助一下贫民，再然后就是遇到格林了。
“竟然撑到了现在吗？从10岁的时候。
还有那个小孩，byd东西。
最好别让我发现你，不然让你飞起来，不，要让你进土里。
可惜古兹不会让我这样做吧。”
格林一边整理资料，一边喃喃自语。
这些资料有格林自己整理的，还有的是帝国军帮忙整理的，至于帝国军为什么要帮格林？
帝国军表示“这位先生用感情征服了我。”
整理完资料后，已经是早上了。
这些东西足以证明古兹的身体没有问题了，嗯，先回房间里吧。
content_en:
Green was carried home by Joan of Arc, and the considerate Joan even took off her armor to make Green more comfortable.
She really made me cry to death.
It's just that the gun is a bit difficult to press, but fortunately Green has become more and more proficient.
If this continues, maybe he can get a headshot.
After solemnly thanking Joan of Arc, Green returned to the room, washed up and walked into his office to study information.
Regarding the issue of the Chamber of Commerce, Green plans to go to the Isabella family to have a taste of the situation and then think about it.
In addition, there is a little trouble, which started three days ago: a viscount's territory is nearby. Seeing that Green's business is so good, he came here to taste it.
But noble? It is inevitable that there will be some airs, and this viscount is a very prominent presence among them.
He believed that civilians should give way to him, that is, jump in line, and then he also wanted to monopolize all the desserts.
Of course, Green would not give him face. After the negotiations were fruitless, the two sides would naturally clash - referring to Green unilaterally knocking the other party to the ground.
After that, the Imperial Army came to mediate. Although Green is currently a civilian, no one can tell what will happen in the future.
After all, no matter what the business cooperation agreement is, it is a fact that the three major chambers of commerce are wooing Green.
The three major chambers of commerce can all see from the new products that Miyufang has continuously launched and the new business model of Miyufang that Green has extraordinary knowledge.
In this world, knowledge can often be associated with beings such as the gods in the heavens or the Demon Lords of the Abyss. People with rich knowledge can easily be noticed by these beings.
Regardless of whether this person is good or bad, anyway, this person may have the blessing of a god-level existence, so this person is worthy of attention.
The Church of the Holy Fire is hostile to the Abyss, and the nobles of the empire are really hostile to the heretics who disrupt the order of the empire, not the entire Abyss.
Some people even use the power of the abyss. After all, the abyss doesn't ask for much in return, because when you seek the power of the abyss, you are already paying the price.
Of course, the fate of such people when discovered by the church is to be judged. Because they believe in the gods of heaven, the church's high-level combat power is more or less blessed.
Although some of the blessings are strange, such as being able to tell the difference between salt and sugar, the combat power is still guaranteed.
Back to the topic, after this incident came to an end, rumors about Miyufang appeared in the neighborhood.
Green could use his brain to figure out who was responsible. Many of the rumors were very low-level.
Without Miyufang's response, the neighbors began to attack the rumor mongers.
In the next two days, the Viscount was looking for trouble, but it didn't hurt. Green wanted to say, isn't this a pure child? But when Green collected intelligence on his own, he discovered something different: someone was talking about Guzi, and that Guzi would bring disaster to others.
Originally, because of Green, Guz's false characteristics were almost forgotten by people, but now they are mentioned again.
Gee, it looks like someone is on a narrow road.
In fact, judging from Green's observations in the past few days, Guz doesn't seem to have any special physique.
Moreover, Guz's hometown is near Delk (the name of the town where Green is currently located), so he did some research there.
Green discovered that Guz's parents died while traveling with the caravan. It was not a misfortune, but an attack by abyssal pagans.
The pagan high priest presided over a large-scale attack on an important city in the west, and the surrounding areas were also attacked to varying degrees.
The caravan that Guzi's parents belonged to was also among them. This can't be called causing a disaster. You can't say that the people in the Twin Towers were attacked because someone with a disaster physique attracted the plane to come over. The reason is not summarized in this way.
And why is Guz still alive? Because the attack was sudden and short-lived, and the high priest sought destruction and speed, the pagans left without noticing a trembling child beneath the bodies of a pair of parents.
Later, Guzi was sent back to her hometown by the imperial army. Guzi was very strong. She relied on the help of her relatives to survive, and something happened next.
I don’t know if it was the child who spread the news, but many people later said that Guzi’s calamitous physique.
Then when Guzi became an adult, he no longer wanted to rely on the help of relatives, so he began to try to live on his own. Later, he found that he could not find a job, so he began to work as a pickpocket, picking out rich people to steal bits and pieces of money.
Those rich people really don't care about this. According to Guz's description, some people don't even realize that they have less money.
After that, Guz still had some energy left to help the poor, and then he met Green.
"Have you managed to survive until now? Since I was 10 years old.
And that kid, byd things.
You'd better not let me find you, otherwise I'll make you fly, no, I'll make you fall into the ground.
It's a pity that Guz won't let me do this. "
Green muttered to himself while sorting out the information.
Some of these materials were compiled by Greene himself, and some were compiled with the help of the Imperial Army. As for why the Imperial Army helped Greene?
The Imperial Army said, "This gentleman conquered me with his emotions."
After sorting out the information, it was already morning.
These things are enough to prove that Guzi's body is fine. Well, let's go back to the room first.
